issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Omniwork
products.tagline: The Creative Agent OS, create better with desktop AI agents
products.summaryZh: 创意代理操作系统，借助桌面AI代理，创作更出色
products.descriptionZh: Omniwork是一款常驻的创意代理操作系统，将想法转化为成品。专业AI代理负责研究、创作、监控并自动化你的创意工作流程，而主动式桌面伴侣则保持项目推进，并将成果、提醒和进度直接推送到你的屏幕。
products.description: Omniwork is an always-on Creative Agent OS that turns ideas into finished work. Specialized AI agents research, create, monitor, and automate your creative workflows, while a proactive desktop companion keeps projects moving and pushes results, alerts, and progress straight to your screen.

products.name: VoiceOS App Store
products.tagline: The app store for voice native apps that lives in your notch
products.summaryZh: 专为语音原生应用打造的应用商店，就藏在你的灵动岛里。
products.descriptionZh: 你的语音应用商店，一句话即可构建。描述你的需求，如“创建一个应用帮我写日记”，VoiceOS便会为你生成应用。以链接分享，任何人一键即可安装。
products.description: The App Store for your voice, where building takes one sentence. Describe what you want "Create an app to help me to journal" and VoiceOS creates the app for you. Share it as a link and anyone can install it in a click.

products.name: Proxy Tester by ScrapeOps
products.tagline: Benchmark proxies for reliable, target-specific scraping
products.summaryZh: 用于可靠、目标定向抓取的基准代理
products.descriptionZh: ScrapeOps Proxy Tester是一个面向开发者、爬虫团队、数据提供商、SaaS公司和AI代理的技术基准测试平台，用于选择代理基础设施。提交目标URL即可测试20多种住宅、数据中心、移动、代理API及解锁器配置。该平台衡量实际成功率、延迟、可靠性、带宽和预估成本，并生成针对特定使用场景的排名，而非依赖供应商的泛泛宣传。
products.description: ScrapeOps Proxy Tester is a technical benchmarking platform for developers, scraping teams, data providers, SaaS companies, and AI agents selecting proxy infrastructure. Submit a target URL to test 20+ residential, datacenter, mobile, Proxy API, and unblocker configurations. It measures real-world success rate, latency, reliability, bandwidth, and estimated cost, then generates a use-case-specific ranking instead of relying on generic provider claims.

products.name: DocsAlot CLI
products.tagline: Let Claude or Codex create and maintain good looking docs
products.summaryZh: 让Claude或Codex创建并维护美观的文档。
products.descriptionZh: Claude Code、Codex或Backboard擅长撰写初稿。DocsAlot能将初稿转化为外观精美的文档站点，并为你的代理提供完整的工作流程，使其保持最新状态。用简单英语即可创建或提取文档、预览更改、迁移现有内容、保存版本，并在批准后才发布。无需记忆命令，也无需手动管理文档工作流。你只需描述目标；代理负责执行，而你始终掌握控制权。
products.description: Claude Code, Codex or Backboard are great at writing a first draft. DocsAlot turns that draft into a genuinely good-looking docs site, and gives your agent a complete workflow for keeping it current. Ask in plain English to create or pull docs, preview changes, migrate existing content, save versions, and publish only when approved. No commands to memorize or documentation workflow to manage by hand. You describe the outcome; your agent handles the work while you stay in control

products.name: AgentConnect
products.tagline: Tag any agent, wherever work happens.
products.summaryZh: 在任何工作场景中标记任何代理。
products.descriptionZh: AgentConnect 是一个开源平台，团队与 AI 代理可在 Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 GitHub 上协同工作。连接 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、DeepSeek、Pi 或任何兼容 ACP 的运行时。为每个代理分配角色，并选择其模型、工作区、记忆、工具、技能和权限。从对话、拉取请求、问题、Webhook 或日程开始工作。代理之间可相互调用，而你的团队则在一个控制台中查看被允许看到的工作进展。
products.description: AgentConnect is an open-source platform where teams and AI agents work together across Slack, Telegram, Discord, and GitHub. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, DeepSeek, Pi, or any ACP-compatible runtime. Give each agent a role and choose its model, workspace, memory, tools, skills, and permissions. Start work from conversations, pull requests, issues, webhooks, or schedules. Agents can call one another while your team follows the work they are allowed to see from one console.

products.name: Prompt Golf
products.tagline: Prompt Engineering As a Sport
products.summaryZh: 提示工程作为一项运动
products.descriptionZh: Prompt Golf将提示工程变成一款竞技解谜游戏。在五轮挑战中，引导一个跳出常规的AI说出精确的目标词或短语，并尽量使用最少的字符。每轮都有特定条件或禁用输入词。每个字符和消息都会增加笔画数，因此巧妙而紧凑的提示能登上实时排行榜。重玩整个课程，查看实时排行榜，挑战朋友并查看他们的对话记录。
products.description: Prompt Golf turns prompt engineering into a competitive puzzle game. Across five rounds, coax an out-of-the-box AI into saying an exact target word or phrase in as less characters as possible. Every round has a condition or banned input words. Every character and message adds strokes, so clever, compact prompts climb the live leaderboard. Replay the full course, check live leaderboard, challenge your friends and view their transcripts.

products.name: ConferenceGrid
products.tagline: Conference database for B2B teams
products.summaryZh: 面向B2B团队的会议数据库
products.descriptionZh: 查找任意公司，即可查看其赞助、参展或演讲的所有会议——在一个图表中涵盖6,000多场会议、62,000位演讲者、55,000个赞助席位。
products.description: Look up any company and see every conference it sponsors, exhibits at, or speaks at — 6,000+ conferences, 62,000 speakers, 55,000 sponsor slots in one graph.

products.name: Argos
products.tagline: The AI that acts as you, right in your browser
products.summaryZh: 在浏览器中，AI化身为你，即刻行动。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI只会告诉你该做什么。Argos则直接执行。它就在你的浏览器内，使用你已登录的账户进行操作——点击、输入、填写表单，完成真实任务。你可以在侧边栏提问，或通过Telegram/WhatsApp发消息，它会实时运行或在后台执行，然后把结果交给你。原生支持Gmail、Docs和Sheets。可连接GitHub、Slack、Notion等更多应用。你的数据保留在设备上。免费开始使用。
products.description: Most AI just tells you what to do. Argos does it. It works right inside your browser using your own logged-in accounts — clicking, typing, filling forms, and finishing real tasks. Ask it in the sidebar or text it on Telegram/WhatsApp, and it runs live or in the background, then hands you the result. Native in Gmail, Docs and Sheets. Connects GitHub, Slack, Notion and more. Your data stays on your device. Free to start.

products.name: Persodex
products.tagline: Your personal CRM that lives on top of your iOS contacts.
products.summaryZh: 您的个人CRM，直接集成于iOS通讯录之上。
products.descriptionZh: 一款更智能的通讯录应用，助您与重要的人保持联系。我们更愿意称之为：带情境的通讯录。Persodex 与苹果通讯录原生同步，而非替代。我们甚至无需账户。无需导入，无需迁移，无锁定。
products.description: A smarter contacts app that helps you stay in touch with the people who matter. Or as we like to call it: Contacts with Context. Persodex syncs natively with Apple’s Contacts instead of replacing them. We don‘t even require an account. No import. No migration. No lock-in.

products.name: DuckDisk
products.tagline: Table-first storage analysis for Mac, cloud, and SSH
products.summaryZh: 面向Mac、云端及SSH的表格优先存储分析
products.descriptionZh: DuckDisk是一款免费、开源的macOS存储分析工具，专为追求答案而非仅看彩色图谱的用户设计。其采用WizTree风格、表格优先的树状视图，在逐层深入时，始终显示大小、占用空间、父级占比、项目数量及文件类型总计。一个应用即可扫描本地磁盘、OneDrive、Google Drive和SSH。云扫描仅使用元数据——不下载文件内容。该版本已通过Apple公证，并可在Mac App Store获取。
products.description: DuckDisk is a free, open-source macOS storage analyzer built for people who want answers, not just colorful maps. Its WizTree-style, table-first tree keeps size, allocated space, parent %, item counts, and file-type totals visible while you drill down. Scan local disks, OneDrive, Google Drive, and SSH in one app. Cloud scans use metadata only—file contents are not downloaded. The release is Apple-notarized and available on the Mac App Store.

products.name: Papaya
products.tagline: Your sex's private recap that never leaves your phone
products.summaryZh: 你性别的私密回顾，永不离身。
products.descriptionZh: Papaya倾听你的性爱过程，并据此绘制一幅卡通画。仅通过声音和动作，在设备上完成：无需账户，不涉及云端，不保存音频。它为夜晚赋予一个标题。我的标题是“比电梯演讲还快”。
products.description: Papaya listens to you having sex and draws a cartoon about it. Sound and motion only, on-device: no account, no cloud, no audio saved. It gives the night a title. Mine was "Faster than an elevator pitch."

products.name: Workflo
products.tagline: Mac workspace automation that never sees your screen
products.summaryZh: Mac工作区自动化，永不窥屏。
products.descriptionZh: Workflo自动配置你的Mac——在通话或专注时段前布置好合适的窗口，并在显示器变化时恢复你的布局。仅依赖辅助功能运行：从结构上就无法读取你的屏幕。原生Swift编写，约4MB，一次性购买，仅本地运行。
products.description: Workflo sets up your Mac automatically — staging the right windows before a call or a focus block, and restoring your layout when displays change. Runs on Accessibility alone: it structurally cannot read your screen. Native Swift, ~4 MB, one-time purchase, local-only.

products.name: Soup CLI
products.tagline: Fine-tune an 8B LLM on a 4 GB laptop GPU
products.summaryZh: 在4 GB笔记本GPU上微调8B LLM
products.descriptionZh: LoRA保持基础模型冻结：只读，从不写入。因此，Soup将其保存在系统内存中，并逐层将解码器层流式传输到GPU。峰值显存占用从整个模型降至单层。在RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB上实测：Llama-3.1-8B训练速度为119.6 tok/s，峰值显存3.32 GB。一个YAML，一条命令。支持SFT、DPO、GRPO、KTO，以及评估、门控和导出。Apache-2.0许可。所有数字均已公开，包括我测量后舍弃的数据。
products.description: LoRA keeps the base model frozen: read, never written. So Soup keeps it in system RAM and streams it into the GPU one decoder layer at a time. Peak VRAM becomes one layer instead of the whole model. Measured on an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB: Llama-3.1-8B trains at 119.6 tok/s in 3.32 GB peak. One YAML, one command. SFT, DPO, GRPO, KTO, plus eval, gating and export. Apache-2.0. Every number is published, including the ones I measured and threw away.

products.name: radiusHQ
products.tagline: One link replaces your scheduling chaos
products.summaryZh: 一个链接取代你的日程混乱。
products.descriptionZh: 您的服务、价格、日历、支付和提醒——全部集中在一个美观的页面上。客户30秒即可完成预约，您10分钟即可完成设置。
products.description: Your services, prices, calendar, payments, and reminders — all in one beautiful page. Clients book in 30 seconds. You set it up in 10 minutes.

products.name: Grok Imagine 2.0
products.tagline: Next-gen AI image generator with segmentation editing.
products.summaryZh: 新一代AI图像生成器，支持分割编辑。
products.descriptionZh: Grok Imagine 2.0为Grok的图像生成能力带来重大升级：指令遵循能力显著提升，文本渲染与排版更加清晰，布局复杂且连贯，并支持通过Magic Wand进行精准区域编辑。
products.description: Grok Imagine 2.0 brings major upgrades to Grok's image generation capabilities: significantly better instruction following, sharp text rendering & typography, complex coherent layouts, and precise region editing with Magic Wand.

products.name: Good Assistant 2
products.tagline: Turn life goals into daily progress.
products.summaryZh: 将人生目标转化为每日进步。
products.descriptionZh: Good Assistant 2 将您的目标转化为每日步骤，并确保其得以实现。与您一同规划每日行程，追踪进度，并助您坚持到底。
products.description: Good Assistant 2 turns your goals into daily steps and makes sure they happen. Plans your day with you, tracks progress, and helps you follow through.

products.name: Bunzee 3.0
products.tagline: Idea → IA → wireframes → design → build via MCP
products.summaryZh: 创意 → 信息架构 → 线框图 → 设计 → 通过MCP构建
products.descriptionZh: AI没有上下文就无法正确构建你的应用——它只是在猜测下一个词元。Bunzee提供完整图景：它对照真实竞争对手和市场数据分析你的想法，然后将一切拆解为结构化规格——PRD、信息架构、线框图，以及你可从250多种全球应用风格中塑造的设计。每一步衔接下一步，每一步都基于客观数据而非主观意见。随后，所有内容通过MCP传输到你的AI编码工具，让你的AI基于真实上下文构建，而非凭空臆测。
products.description: AI can't build your app right without context—it's just guessing the next token. Bunzee gives it the full picture: it analyzes your idea against real competitors and market data, then breaks everything into structured specs—PRD, IA, wireframes, and designs you can shape from 250+ global app styles. Each step feeds the next, and every one is grounded in objective data, not opinion. Then it all pipes to your AI coding tool over MCP, so your AI builds from real context, not vibes.

products.name: TAKT
products.tagline: Stop babysitting AI coding agents — reviews can't be skipped
products.summaryZh: 别再当AI编程助手的保姆了——审查无法跳过
products.descriptionZh: 开源命令行工具，将AI编程代理（如Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等）转化为可重复的YAML工作流：规划→实施→审查→修复循环，支持分步骤角色、隔离工作树和可追踪报告。审查无法被静默跳过。
products.description: Open-source CLI that turns AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & more) into repeatable YAML workflows: plan → implement → review → fix loops with per-step roles, isolated worktrees, and traceable reports. Reviews can't be silently skipped.

products.name: SoloUno
products.tagline: Take control of hair pulling, nail biting & skin picking
products.summaryZh: 掌控拔毛、咬指甲与抓挠皮肤的行为。
products.descriptionZh: SoloUno帮助人们掌控身体聚焦重复行为（BFRBs），如拔毛癖（trichotillomania）、皮肤搔抓症（dermatillomania）和咬指甲。受习惯逆转训练、认知行为疗法和接纳承诺疗法启发，它作为一款游戏化的自助工具运作。通过实现每日小胜利来取得进展：无习惯挑战与连续记录、快速习惯记录、触发因素分析以及冲动接纳练习。无需羞愧——只需稳步前进。
products.description: SoloUno helps people take control over body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs) such as hair pulling (trichotillomania), skin picking (dermatillomania), and nail biting. Inspired by Habit Reversal Training, CBT, and ACT, it works as a gamified self-help tool. You progress by achieving small daily wins: habit-free challenges and streaks, quick habit logging, trigger analysis, and urge-acceptance sessions. No shame - just steady progress.

products.name: Macrobite
products.tagline: The fastest way to actually get your macros right
products.summaryZh: 真正掌握宏量营养素的最快方法
products.descriptionZh: Macrobite是快速精准记录宏量营养素的最快方式。拍下餐食照片，即刻获得热量、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪的详细分解。首次识别不准确？快速编辑几秒内即可修正，无需在庞大的食物数据库中翻找。偏好语音？可通过语音记录餐食，包括通过Siri。从iPhone小组件或Apple Watch直接追踪每日摄入，无需打开应用。专为追求精准宏量营养素记录、又厌倦传统追踪应用繁琐操作的人群设计。
products.description: Macrobite is the fastest way to get your macros right. Snap a photo of your meal and get an instant breakdown of calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Not perfect on the first try? Quick editing closes the gap in seconds, no scrolling through massive food databases. Prefer to talk? Log meals by voice, including through Siri. Track your day from your iPhone widget or Apple Watch without opening the app. Built for people who want accurate macros without the friction of traditional tracking apps.
